issues.explanation: Chapter 32 says Yuan Shang became overconfident after personally killing Shi Huan, but Chapter 31 correctly depicts him killing Shi Huan with a back-shot arrow after fleeing. The changed method and implication of a direct melee kill conflict across the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the opening to say Yuan Shang, proud after killing Shi Huan with an arrow, led troops from Liyang to face Cao's army.
